# Scale Shift Studio

> Independent game, website and mobile app development studio based in Vadodara, Gujarat, India. Works with clients worldwide and publishes its own games.

## Pages
- [Home](https://scaleshift.studio/): services (websites, mobile apps, UI/UX, AI automation, game development, game co-development), games and how to contact us.
- [Rocket Booster](https://scaleshift.studio/games/rocket-booster/): our physics-based 3D rocket game for Android, coming soon to Google Play.
- [Privacy Policy](https://scaleshift.studio/privacy/)
